marketing_description: The VELUX FS C06 2004S Fixed Skylight features a laminated, Low-E3 glass and a pre-finished wood frame in gray/white, providing a durable and low-maintenance solution for bringing natural light into a space. This deck-mount skylight has a daylight area of 4.43 sq-ft and is designed for easy installation with a rough opening width of 21 in and height of 45-7/8 in. It also comes with a white room-darkening solar powered shade for added functionality.
